stations.title: Rhona
stations.say: Can the laptop read the radio check?

stations.title: Base laptop
stations.text: Says it is on, then points to the old base.

stations.title: Radio desk
stations.text: The check is printed and ready to read.

captions: First night at the Brackenridge base. Rhona wants the laptop to print the radio check.
Today the laptop says it is on and points people to the old base, but prints no check.
You write the lines that print it, in four small tasks.
Now the name and the radio check print, and the old base is switched off.
One file, run with python3. The laptop talks, and Rhona has the radio check.
